jobs.occupation: Regional Material Flow Expert (all genders) (Fachkraft - Logistik/Materialwirtschaft)
jobs.description: Your Tasks- Analyze end-to-end internal material flows from receiving and storage through line supply to FG staging and dispatch, with strong shopfloor presence.- Build fact-based current-state analyses using Value Stream Mapping, spaghetti diagrams, time-and-motion studies, route/distance analysis, throughput, capacity, inventory, space and handling data.- Identify bottlenecks, non-value-added movements, excess handling, waiting, inventory, space constraints, ergonomic issues and safety risks; prioritize improvement opportunities.- Design future-state logistics processes and layouts, including receiving, storage, supermarkets, replenishment, line feeding, internal transport, and FG flows.- Define and optimize replenishment concepts and material-flow parameters such as Kanban, milk-run routes, line-side presentation, buffers and JIT/JIS principles where applicable.- Assess and size material-handling and automation solutions (e.g., forklifts, tuggers, conveyors, AGV) based on demand, capacity, safety, flexibility and cost.- Lead cross-functional shopfloor workshops, Kaizen activities, pilots and implementation work; test, stabilize and standardize solutions together with operators and local teams.- Quantify benefits and trade-offs through productivity, inventory, space, CAPEX, payback analyses; support robust business cases and implementation decisions.- Define relevant KPIs, track realized improvements, document standards and prepare concise management presentations explaining findings, recommendations, risks and progress.- Identify transferable solutions and synergies across factories; share standards and lessons learned within the network and with Global Factory Logistics.- Compliance with health, safety, fire-protection and site procedures, and for ensuring that logistics concepts are designed with safe material handling and traffic management in mind.- Protection of the environment and natural resources through efficient use of materials, utilities, handling equipment and space, and through waste reduction and proper segregation.Your Profile- University degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain/LogisticsProduction/Manufacturing Engineering or a comparable field.- Several years of relevant professional experience, ideally including hands-on experience in plant logistics and material flow within an automotive or manufacturing environment.- Strong expertise in material flow, logistics process design, capacity and inventory planning, Lean principles and factory flow optimization.- Experience in leading cross-functional initiatives and driving improvements from analysis through implementation.- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a hands-on, pragmatic working style.- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels.- Fluent English; German is an advantage.- Willingness to travel regularly across European manufacturing sites and work on-site for extended periods when required.At Beiersdorf, we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. For 140 years, we have developed innovative skin and body care products for well-known brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.Behind every brand, every product and every accomplishment are our more than 20,000 employees. It is for them that we live an inclusive culture of respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values – CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY and TRUST. jobs.occupation: Chartering Broker (f/m/d) – Regional Trade & Project Cargo (Intra-Europe) (Schifffahrtskaufmann/-frau - Trampfahrt)
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Briese Chartering is an established Shipowner/Carrier based in Leer/Germany managing a modern and versatile fleet of short-sea and multipurpose (MPP) vessels ranging from 3,000 to 10,000 DWT with a strong focus on carriage of project cargo. For further information see: www.briese-chartering.com (http://www.briese-chartering.com/)   We are seeking an experienced Chartering Broker to join our Intra-Europe Regional Trade desk. In this role you will hold commercial responsibility for maximizing the utilization and profitability of our owned and controlled tonnage. You will optimize vessel loops across Europe, securing high-yielding regional breakbulk and specialized project cargo stems by maintaining direct relationships with industrial charterers, shippers and project forwarders.Negotiate charter parties directly with cargo owners and competitive brokers, protecting the company's commercial interests. Fleet Optimization & Chartering Fix our 3,000–10,000 DWT fleet on Voyage Charters and Contracts of Affreightment (COAs) across European trade routes (Baltic, North Sea, Continent, Mediterranean/Black Sea and North/West Africa). Optimize vessel routing and scheduling to minimize ballast days and maximize daily time charter equivalent returns.Project Cargo & Voyage Estimation Evaluate and price specialized project cargo inquiries tailored to our vessels' capabilities. Perform precise voyage calculations including bunker tracking, port/terminal expenses, and laytime analysis to ensure optimal margins. Market Integration & Collaboration Leverage the north/central European shipping community while managing an active network of international chartering contacts. Work closely with our in-house operations and technical management teams in Leer to guarantee smooth post-fixture execution. Qualifications & Experience  Essential Criteria - Minimum 3 years of commercial experience on the owner’s side or with an exclusive broker specifically within the European short-sea or small-MPP sectors. - Solid understanding of 3k–10k DWT vessel capabilities including stowage configurations, deck strength and regional port/canal restrictions. - Deep knowledge of European trades including seasonal weather factors, ice clauses and short-sea port operations. - Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German is highly preferred given our regional hub and team integration. Core Skills - Commercial drive with a clear focus on asset P&L and strategic fleet positioning. - Proficiency in voyage estimation and other standard software tools (MS Office, Sedna, Netpas, etc.). - Existing network of direct project cargo clients, industrial shippers and European forwarders.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Verhandlungsführung, Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnung, SchifffahrtsrechtExpertenkenntnisse: Befrachtung
